mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0006.retrievePayrollItemDetailList */ pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AS detail_id , pid.additional_input_value AS detail_name , pid.pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code AS detail_type_code , cccm.common_code_name AS detail_Type_name , pid.sort_order_no /* PAY_VALUE 행은 수정/삭제 불가능 처리 */ ,(SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(class_c.code_data2_value, 'X') = pid.additional_input_value THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FROM lgcom_common_code_c class_c WHERE class_c.code_type_code = 'LGDVHR_PAY_CLASS_TYPE_CODE' AND class_c.common_code = ppi.pay_item_classification_code ) AS edit_enable_flag /* 수정 가능여부 */ FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm WHERE ppi.payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_ITEM_DETAIL_TYPE_CODE' AND cccm.code_type_code = ccc.code_type_code AND cccm.common_code = ccc.common_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND ccc.common_code = pid.pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code ORDER BY pid.sort_order_no

WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 Detail 항목 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAYP0006.retireveValidateData */ pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AS detail_id , pid.additional_input_value AS detail_name , pid.pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code AS detail_type_code , pid.sort_order_no FROM tb_pay_item_detail_n pid WHERE pid.payroll_item_id = #{parameter.payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ AND pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id NOT IN #{deleted[${idx}].detailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) , rs AS ( SELECT -1 AS detail_id , #{created[${idx}].detailName} AS detail_name , #{created[${idx}].detailTypeCode} AS detail_type_code , #{created[${idx}].sortOrderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS sort_order_no FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT detail_list.detail_id , NVL(update_list.detail_name , detail_list.detail_name ) AS detail_name , NVL(update_list.detail_type_code, detail_list.detail_type_code) AS detail_type_code , NVL(update_list.sort_order_no , detail_list.sort_order_no ) AS sort_order_no FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT #{updated[${idx}].detailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS detail_id , #{updated[${idx}].detailName} AS detail_name , #{updated[${idx}].detailTypeCode} AS detail_type_code , #{updated[${idx}].sortOrderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS sort_order_no FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.detail_id = update_list.detail_id(+) SELECT detail_list.detail_id , detail_list.detail_name , detail_list.detail_type_code , detail_list.sort_order_no FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.detail_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.detail_name) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_names FROM rs GROUP BY rs.detail_name HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_names /* 중복된 Detail 항목명 */ ,(SELECT DISTINCT listagg(rs.sort_order_no, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.sort_order_no) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) AS dup_names FROM rs GROUP BY rs.sort_order_no HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) AS dup_sort_names /* 중복된 정렬순서번호 */ ,(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > a.limit_row THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM rs ) AS limit_row_over_flag /* Detail 항목 10건 초과인지 여부 */ , a.limit_row /* 등록 가능한 최대 건수 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'label.pay.detailName' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_names_title ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'SortOrder' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_sort_names_title FROM (SELECT 10 as limit_row /* 등록 가능한 최대 건수 */ FROM dual) a
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAYP0006.insertPayrollItemDetail */ INTO tb_pay_item_detail_n( payroll_item_detail_detail_id /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , payroll_item_id /* 급여항목아이디 */ , additional_input_value /* 추가입력문자값 */ , pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code /* 급여산출실적상세구분코드 */ , sort_order_no /* 정렬순서번호 */ , creation_date /* 생성일자 */ , creation_user_id /* 생성사용자아이디 */ ) VALUES ( sq_tb_pay_item_detail_n.nextval /* payroll_item_detail_detail_id => 급여항목상세내역아이디 */ , #{payrollItemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* payroll_item_id => 급여항목아이디 */ , #{detailName} /* additional_input_value => 추가입력문자값 */ , #{detailTypeCode} /* pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code => 급여산출실적상세구분코드 */ , #{sortOrderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* sort_order_no => 정렬순서번호 */ , SYSDATE /* creation_date => 생성일자 */ , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} /* creation_user_id => 생성사용자아이디 */ )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVPAYP0006.updatePayrollItemDetail */ tb_pay_item_detail_n SET additional_input_value = #{detailName} /* 추가입력문자값 */ , pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code = #{detailTypeCode} /* 급여산출실적상세구분코드 */ , sort_order_no = #{sortOrderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 정렬순서번호 */ WHERE payroll_item_detail_detail_id = #{detailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAYP0006.deletePayrollItemDetail */ FROM tb_pay_item_detail_n WHERE payroll_item_detail_detail_id = #{detailId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 급여항목상세내역아이디 */
